detailed_descriptions_html.en:
As a terrible storm rages on, Tabby finds herself once again trapped in a never-ending nightmare. Uncover the mystery of the curse or succumb to it in the sequel to the 2020 horror game, House.

Featuring:

  • Explore a house that changes and reacts to your actions in real-time

  • Experiment with different items to try and survive

  • Challenging, non-linear gameplay with multiple endings

  • Play retro games on the BarkStation

  • Die in gruesomely elaborate ways in a hand-drawn story book artstyle

  • Race against the clock to try and escape a deadly time-loop

  • Save or slay your family, the choice is yours...Or is it?
